name: __utmb
description: This is one of the four main cookies set by the Google Analytics service which enables website owners to track visitor behaviour and measure site performance. Any activity by a user within the 30 minute life span will count as a single visit, even if the user leaves and then returns to the site. A return after 30 minutes will count as a new visit, but a returning visitor.
